question: Across every calendar date in 2025, including dates with zero Delivered orders, what was the average number of Delivered orders for each weekday? Which weekday had the highest average?

action.query:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT d.DATE_DAY, d.DAY_NAME,
         COUNT_IF(o.IS_DELIVERED = TRUE) AS DELIVERED_ORDERS
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_DATE d
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
    ON o.ORDER_DATE = d.DATE_DAY
  WHERE d.DATE_DAY >= '2025-01-01' AND d.DATE_DAY < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY d.DATE_DAY, d.DAY_NAME
)
SELECT DAY_NAME AS WEEKDAY,
       AVG(DELIVERED_ORDERS) AS AVG_DELIVERED_ORDERS_PER_CALENDAR_DATE,
       COUNT(*) AS CALENDAR_DATES
FROM daily
GROUP BY DAY_NAME
ORDER BY AVG_DELIVERED_ORDERS_PER_CALENDAR_DATE DESC

action.answer: Across all calendar dates in 2025, including dates with zero Delivered orders, the average Delivered orders per date was: Monday 9,094.365385 (52 dates); Tuesday 9,082.788462 (52); Wednesday 9,053.773585 (53); Thursday 9,473.653846 (52); Friday 12,228.980769 (52); Saturday 14,486.211538 (52); Sunday 13,119.134615 (52). Saturday had the highest average: 14,486.211538 Delivered orders per Saturday.
